name: Princess Holiday
source:
Two women with boring lives that never change
meet up one fateful night... and from that meeting create
an unforgettable memory beyond world, age and gender---

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE139986.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
两个女人的无聊生活永远不会改变
在一个决定性的夜晚相遇……并从那次相遇中创造
超越世界、年龄、性别的难忘记忆——

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE139986.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
